# Edvana

> Edvana is a live lecture capture and classroom engagement platform. Real-time transcription, AI-generated check-in questions, confidence-based learning, and post-session analytics for higher education and corporate training.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Product overview, features, and pricing for instructors and institutions.
- [Learn more](/learn-more): Expanded walkthrough of the instructor and student experience.
- [Corporate Events](/corporate/events): Edvana for conferences, summits, and corporate events.
- [Corporate Enterprise](/corporate/enterprise): Enterprise training and L&D positioning.
- [Booth Flyer](/flyer): One-page printable overview of the platform.

## Optional

- [Privacy Policy](/privacy): How Edvana collects, uses, and protects user data.
- [Accessibility Statement](/accessibility): Edvana's accessibility commitments and standards.
